_doc: Process parameters for the digital twin (and the simulator). Carbonate chemistry with temperature-dependent constants (water_temp sensor; 25 C if not measured). naoh_feed_strength converts the lye feed setpoint (ppm of feed solution) into mg/L NaOH actually added. baffling_cells: the clearwell as N stirred tanks in series (from your tracer study / baffling factor; 1 = unbaffled). kla_per_hr: CO2 exchange with air (0 = covered tank; fitted by calibration). chlorine_demand = demand_base + demand_per_ntu * turbidity.
_doc_alkali: Chemical on the alkali feed (the naoh_dose register, whatever it holds): naoh, lime, soda_ash or bicarbonate. Chlorine-only plants: leave naoh_dose out of tags.json.
_doc_example: Same plant as config/process.json, but chlorinated with chlorine gas and fluoridated with fluorosilicic acid.
_doc_chlorine_source: hypochlorite (liquid bleach, default) or gas: chlorine gas uses up ~1.4 mg/L alkalinity per mg/L fed, so pH drops.
_doc_fluoride_chemical: fsa (fluorosilicic acid, ~2.6 mg/L alkalinity used per mg/L F), na2sif6 (sodium fluorosilicate, ~1.75) or naf (sodium fluoride, 0).
